title: Live Preview tab (top, alongside Timeline): debounced auto-republish + Ruffle hot-reload, error-resilient, live-dev controls
description: USER FEATURE: a live preview tab at the TOP alongside the Timeline, with modern frontend-style DX. Behavior: debounce re-publish to SWF on document changes and auto-reload Ruffle with the new SWF; gracefully handle compile errors (only reload on SUCCESSFUL publish, keep the last-good preview otherwise). EXPLORE FIRST (cite file:line): how publishing/compiling works (compileDocument in packages/swf compile.ts + usePublish/useExportHandlers), how Ruffle is embedded/loaded today (packages/player wrapper + any existing preview), where the Timeline docks at the top and how its tab host is structured (Shell.tsx), and the documentStore change subscription. IMPLEMENT: (1) A Live Preview tab hosted at the top alongside Timeline (add to that tab area; if Timeline isn't currently tabbed, introduce a minimal tab strip there without disrupting the Timeline). (2) An embedded Ruffle instance that loads the compiled SWF. (3) Debounced auto-republish (~300-500ms) subscribed to doc changes: compile in the background, cancel/supersede in-flight compiles, and on SUCCESS swap the SWF into Ruffle; on COMPILE ERROR keep the last good SWF and show a non-blocking error overlay/banner (React-error-overlay style) with the message(s). (4) A status pill: Up-to-date / Compiling… / Error. (5) Live-dev controls: auto-reload toggle, manual Reload + Restart buttons, Start-from-scene selector, Start-from-frame input (begin playback at that scene/frame), play/pause, mute, quality, background, zoom/scale-to-fit, and optionally loop + show SWF size/compile-time. Be thoughtful — add genuinely useful live-dev affordances (DX akin to React fast-refresh). (6) Persist preview prefs (auto-reload on/off, start scene/frame, quality, zoom) via the editorLayout/preferences pattern. (7) Performance: don't block the UI thread on compile; debounce + supersede; avoid leaking Ruffle instances on unmount/tab switch. REUSE the existing publish + player code paths; do NOT duplicate the compiler. VERIFY: build + authoring-ui tests green (only ~3 task-1207 fixture failures acceptable); unit tests for the debounce/supersede + error-keeps-last-good logic; ideally a Playwright e2e (edit the doc -> preview SWF updates; introduce a compile error -> preview stays + error shown). Update docs/. ACQUIRE lock; commit incl task file; push rebase-retry (Shell.tsx is a hotspot — rebase carefully; no other active agent currently edits Shell). Scope: new LivePreviewPanel + top-tab wiring in Shell + debounced-compile hook + Ruffle embed + preview prefs (+tests). If the scope proves too large for one pass, implement the core loop (tab + debounced republish + error handling + a couple of controls) first and report what remains for a follow-up.
